Adds the current order book of each outcome to market items: best prices, spread and depth.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `polymarket.orderbook` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Depth (`depth`) | whole number | no | `5` | Price levels summed into bidDepth and askDepth. |
